## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt` applied
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` is clean
- [ ] `cargo test` passes with no test documents present
- [ ] No real document, or text from one, is committed or pasted
- [ ] Any new claim about the format is marked **observed** or **ASSUMPTION** in
      the source, and `FORMAT-NOTES.md` is updated if it belongs there
- [ ] The commit message follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
      (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, …), since releases are generated from it
